description: This file contains test specifications for the NotesService, verifying functionalities such as creating, updating, and deleting notes, as well as persistence to localStorage.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing notes, including create, update, delete, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified properties and saves it to localStorage.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the note with the given ID with new properties.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its unique identifier.

ctags.name: created
ctags.pattern: /^    const created = service.create({ title: 'Hello', content: 'World', tags: ['a', 'b'] });$/

ctags.name: created
ctags.pattern: /^    const created = service.create({ title: 'One', content: '', tags: [] });$/

ctags.name: created
ctags.pattern: /^    const created = service.create({ title: 'To delete', content: '', tags: [] });$/
